gen-almendra-display-gf-suwannaphum: Ornate and bookish, Almendra Display never pinches its letters shut. And Suwannaphum, a classic serif with a tall, squared-off lowercase, carries a long page with dignified, editorial steadiness.
gen-gf-goldman-poppins: Goldman spreads its letters wide, with a lowercase that towers over the capitals. Poppins follows in smooth, rope-loose curves of one line width, so the pair holds a bold command up top and a modern, sturdy ease underneath.
gen-gf-wallpoet-mulish: Mulish reads smooth and flat, with horseshoe-open curves. Wallpoet brings stencil-like gaps between its high-rising letters, and that sharp gap against Mulish's soft, unmodulated lines is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-megrim-inter: Megrim cuts every stroke to the same hairline measure, its open c and skyward lowercase looking like a sketch of the future. Inter fills in beneath with big, breathing counters.
gen-tourney-rubik: Athletic and loud, Tourney stretches its marker-tip letters out with wide tracking and bulky small forms. Rubik's soft, big-bodied sans keeps a longer read friendly.
gen-gf-grandstander-poppins: Grandstander keeps its lines plain and its letters held open. Poppins handles the quiet work below, its sans curves running loose and sturdy where the heading stays bold and expressive up top.
gen-gf-warnes-mulish: Ink-brush swagger, stretched wide with spacing. Mulish, a friendly sans with horseshoe-open curves and no stroke modulation at all, takes over below and gives Warnes room to be loud.
gen-mystery-quest-inter: Inter reads with big breathing counters and a smooth, tube-like line. Mystery Quest, bookish and nostalgic, adds open-jawed curves above, and that old-world flavor against a neutral sans-serif is what sticks.
gen-audiowide-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab opens its c wide at any size. Audiowide's tile-like glyphs, set with wide gaps and no thick-thin shift, give the pair a futuristic jolt against that dignified text serif.
gen-audiowide-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One sits low and literary, with shallow ascenders and a generous e. Audiowide draws its tile-like letters with one fixed nib for a tech edge, while Fauna One does the quiet, dignified reading.
